meta.notes: A status effect whose behaviour is a script. msm:on_tick fires msm_examples:antidote_tick once a second, and its run_script action calls the handler msm_examples:antidote_cure. In an effect's events, other (and self) is the mob or player that has the effect. Its icon is textures/mob_effect/antidote.png. Give it with /effect give @s msm_examples:antidote 30 1.
